_doc: UNARMED strand pose table (v2/unarmed): same schema as v2/mocap/poses_mocap.json (rig_lib.pose keys per bone, forearm.* elbows, off, absz/lift). idle/run/dash/jump/hurt re-picked or arm-layered for an unarmed girl (scripts/uactions.py); walk = mocap strand keys unchanged. katana key kept for schema compatibility (render with katana 0).
rig: v2/hy3d/rigs/G/parts posed by v2/throw/scripts/rig_lib.py (ELBOW=1, MOCAP=1); render v2/unarmed/scripts/frames_U.py
camera: ortho, 30 deg elevation, 48 px figure, 64x64 cell

licences.bandai1: Bandai Namco Research Motion Dataset-1, CC BY-NC 4.0
licences.bandai2: Bandai Namco Research Motion Dataset-2, CC BY-NC 4.0
licences.cmu: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (free for any use)

idle.note: CMU 13_11 relaxed standing (frames 36-52 mean) + procedural layer: side-to-side weight transfer (hold on R leg / hold on L leg, 300 ms each = PMD idle holds) with a knee dip ~2 px through each transfer, breath, head tilt following the weight, relaxed soft-elbow arms with lagged pendulum sway

walk.note: Bandai1 walk_active cycle 58-90; contact/down/pass keys at gait events; swing x1.25 about the cycle mean

run.note: CMU 02_03 jog cycle R strike 10 -> 104 (0.78 s real -> 440 ms); swing x1.5 about the cycle mean, +14 deg lean, flight x2.2; arm layer: pump gain 1.35, +22 deg forward bias, elbow >= 85

jump.note: CMU 16_03 high jump (keys/timing as mocap strand); arm layer (absolute set pitch/abd/elbow): arms swing up from launch (fwd 75) through rise (55/70) to a cheerful V arms-up apex (abd 135), arms out to the sides on the fall (abd 85), soft balance on land (abd 40)

dash.note: CMU 143_03 start-to-run (antic/drive) + CMU 127_05 run-to-quick-stop (skid/rise); drive x1.4 + 8 deg lean; arm layer (set): sprint pump alternating fwd 75/elbow 105 vs back -50/elbow 80 in phase with the mocap legs; skid/recover each faced forward (no spin); skid balancing arms out-back (set -20/42/30), relaxed recover

hurt.note: LaFAN1 pushAndStumble1_subject5 pushed from the front (NC-ND reference); reaction x2 about pre-hit frame 545; arm layer: startled flinch (hands up beside the head, set 70/55/100) on recoil, arms out for balance on the stagger (35/50/60), stagger leans back 12 deg with the step amp x1.2 (x2 read as a forward lunge)
